name: @dsh-android/linux-bootstrap
description: Bootstrap and settings plugin for the DSH Mobile Debian Linux runtime (experimental internal plugin: shipped in the built-in hard plugin directory, not enabled by default)

dshVendor.excludedFromVendor: test/ (upstream test/client.test.mjs + react-resolver/react-stub hooks depend on a host-provided react peer and POSIX-only cases)
deviations: exports/main point at ./lib: the snapshot injector carries lib/** plus package.json; this tree is built by build.mjs, not published as-is
build script added (copies src/ to lib/ and bundles the client entry as lib/client.js); no build artifact is committed
test script dropped: upstream test/ is intentionally not vendored (see excludedFromVendor)
private: true so the vendored copy can never be published
src/asset-bundle.js locally hardened: always authenticate and independently extract archive bytes; never reuse size-only slots or host unpacked trees
src/index.js requires approved manifests for discovery, installation and reinstall; no optional verification bypass
apply resolves dataDir from explicit config, declared linuxBootstrapConfig or DSH_FILES_DIR; it never reads unprovided Cordis ctx.filesDir
src/index.js locally patched to persist install diagnostics with a stable code and expose only a sanitized status summary
